title: A supplement stop carries no erase: it rides on the store's erase mark
evidence: Done 2026-11-25. PR 2070 passed the erase at the press (hooks/useListSaves.ts handleSupplementDelete); its writeRefused() still names none (unchanged). R5 PR 3 (2026-11-25): the erase is a required argument by type on every RoadmapStore and lib/roadmap-data.ts writer, on RecordSession.refuses and .edit (packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts: the fallback default `erase = this.shownErase` is gone), and on the web upload Save's state (storage/upload-save-store.ts WebSaving; the phone's door still omits it). A writer that forgets it does not compile: storage/roadmap-store-erase-argument.test.ts `writersRequireAnErase` (one @ts-expect-error per writer) and its table (each writer under an older erase refused, record JSON unchanged; under the shown erase it lands). Before: Root fix R5 (triage 2026-11-25): every store write takes its erase as a required argument, then the store mark goes. Partial 2026-11-25 (PR 2070): hooks/useListSaves.ts handleSupplementDelete passes getShownErase() to deleteSupplementApi(key, erase) in lib/roadmap-data.ts. Its writeRefused() still names none (useErase.ts writeRefused). Test: storage/roadmap-store-erase-argument.test.ts (pin), useListSaves.test.tsx. Left: erase-by-type steps 3 and 4 make the erase required by the type, then the mark leaves health-core.
